sloka: भरतात्तु महाबाहोरसितो नाम जायत ।यस्यैते प्रतिराजान उदपद्यन्त शत्रव: ।हैहयास्तालजङ्घाश्च शूराश्च शशिबिन्दव: ॥ २.११०.१५॥
transliteration: bharatāttu mahābāhorasito nāma jāyata ।yasyaite pratirājāna udapadyanta śatrava: ।haihayāstālajaṅghāśca śūrāśca śaśibindava: ॥ 2.110.15॥

translations.english: Mightyarmed Bharata had a son named Asita against whom the Haihayas, Talajanghas and the indomitable Sasibindus, the rival kings rose as enenmies.
